contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

An silver penny of Cuthred, King of Kent (798-807); Portrait Type; mint: Canterbury (804-807). Moneyer: Werheard; North 211; Naismith C35.1. Dimensions: 18.6mm diameter, 0.4mm thick. Weight: 1.27g. Inscription: + CVÐRED REX CANT [Cuthred Rex Cantuariorum, Cuthred King of the Kentish]. Inscription: + VERHEARD MONETA [Werheard the Moneyer or Coin of Werheard]
